name: Cotton T-Shirt
review_summary: Customers love the soft fabric and true-to-size fit, but a few report shrinkage after washing.
sustainability_notes: Made from 100% organic cotton; dyed using low-water process.

name: Leather Jacket
review_summary: Praised for durability and classic styling; some find it runs slightly large.
sustainability_notes: Genuine leather has a high environmental footprint; consider vegan-leather alternatives.

name: Peanut Butter Cookies (Packaged)
review_summary: Rich peanut flavor, though some find them overly sweet.
sustainability_notes: Packaging is recyclable cardboard; palm oil sourcing not certified sustainable.

name: Sneakers
review_summary: Comfortable for daily wear and running; cushioning wears down after ~6 months of heavy use.
sustainability_notes: Upper made from recycled polyester; sole is non-recyclable EVA foam.

name: Greek Yogurt Cup
review_summary: Creamy texture and good protein content; some find the plastic cup wasteful.
sustainability_notes: Single-use plastic cup, not widely recyclable in most municipal programs.

name: Backpack
review_summary: Spacious and durable, laptop compartment well-padded; zippers feel flimsy to a minority of users.
sustainability_notes: Made from recycled nylon (rPET); water-resistant coating is PFC-free.
